decisions.reason: After several years on the market, this consumer-health supplement appears to have cleared the firm's minimum aspiration level, and its strong fit with portfolio expansion and low carrying cost favor retention.

This joint-health supplement is less central and likely more modest in demand than B, but if it remains in the range by 2022 it probably performs acceptably enough relative to aspiration to justify keeping it.

The migraine triptan is more distant from the established offer and uses more demanding commercial and regulatory resources, so it faces a higher review risk, yet continued presence suggests results are not sufficiently below aspiration to warrant dropping it now.
